title: 第10章 银城执法队（求收藏求推荐）
content_zh:
晚上10点。
轰隆隆！
一阵车鸣声响起，寂静的老街，很久没有这么热闹过了。
这一刻，灯光耀射，整个老街区域都活了起来。
张家门前。
李皓默默地看着这一幕，他不希望太高调，但是情况到了这地步，他已经开始和红影有接触了，李皓也转变了思路。
大隐隐于市！
高调，也许也是另外一种低调。
高调到，让所有人都知道，自己就是为了给张远报仇，没有别的目的，没有别的发现，不得不借助外力，不知道背后存在的危机，不知道内情，就胡乱折腾。
这样的李皓，也许是一些人希望看到的李皓。
年轻，冲动，莽撞，但是讲义气！
有头脑，但是缺乏一些算计。
有小聪明，没有大智慧。
这就是李皓要树立的一个形象！
降低敌人的戒备心，又不会让人觉得特别蠢，太蠢了，李皓如何能入袁硕法眼，那就真的太假了。
没走一步，李皓都会去思考，这一步会给自己带来什么，失去什么？
明明只是取走一块小石头，他却是大张旗鼓，弄的满城风雨！
而动静如此之大，就是为了遮掩他取走了一块小石头，传出去，恐怕都没人会相信，而这就是李皓需要的结果，越是夸张，越是没人会往这方面去想。
轰隆隆！
皮靴踩地的声音传来，一队全副武装的巡检，迅速包围了整个老街，很快，张家门口，也都是巡检司的巡检。

巡检司的司长没有过来。
但是，李皓一眼认出了人群前方的那位壮汉，巡检司执法队的大队长，甚至可以说是巡检司真正的二把手。
说是和机要室室长王杰同级，实际上权柄完全不同。
执法队的大队长刘隆，块头不小。
没有穿黑色巡检服，而是穿着便服，外面披着一件风衣，在这个季节，并不合时宜。
李皓却是知道，风衣之下，也许就是密密麻麻的武器。
这位执法队大队长的作风，他知道。
很强硬，也很彪悍的一个人。
银城巡检司，在银城还是很有地位的，这位大队长手上人命都不少。
“谁是李皓？”
刘隆一步上前，脚下皮靴甚至踩碎了地上的石子，隔着老远看到的李皓，眼神一个闪烁。
是个高手！
巡检司也许没有超能神秘者，然而，也有一些搏击高手，还有一些实战高手，都是以一敌十的存在。
这位执法队大队长，显然战力不弱。
“报告，我是李皓！”
李皓也迅速上前，站直了腰杆，挺胸而出，声音干脆利落。
“银城巡检司机要室三级巡检李皓！奉命查案，见过刘队长！”
“哼！”
刘隆一声冷哼，声音格外的冷厉。
如同利剑的眼神，投向李皓，带着一些森冷，带着一些威严和怒火：“李皓，作为巡检司一员，你是巡检司的耻辱！”

李皓皱眉。
刘隆声音极大，带着一些不甘和愤怒，如同猛虎咆哮，甚至不在乎任何人听到。
“巡检司是什么？是执法机构！是整个银城唯一，也是最关键的执法机构！你作为巡检司一员，有任何发现，任何危机，完全可以直接通过巡检司寻求帮助！”
“为何通过外人之手，干涉巡检司执法？”
刘隆声音极大，带着猛虎般的威慑力，一步上前，靠近李皓，这一步，好像跨越了百十米，眨眼间就出现在了李皓眼前。
李皓心中一凝。
真的高手！
他见过刘隆，却是没有见过这种状态下的刘隆，李皓觉得自己还是小有身手的，可他相信，自己在这位面前，也许连枪都拔不出来。
这……算是神秘者吗？
还是说，这只是普通人锻炼到了极致，产生的一种威能？
李皓有些被威慑住了，低下了头颅，带着一些颤动，低声道：“不敢！我只是寻求我老师的帮助，没想到会让巡检司这边大动干戈，因为我没证据，所以没好意思寻求巡检司帮助……”
刘隆哼了一声，又好像认可了这样的回复，冷漠道：“没有证据，那就找！为何不好意思？说说，此地到底发生了什么？”
李皓压下心中的震动，低声道：“自焚案，我已经上报，不知刘队知否？”
“知道！”
“我和张远是好友，今晚我想来查查，张远家是否有什么线索，因为我确信张远是被人杀害，而不是死于意外……”
李皓镇定了下来，沉声道：“我来张远家，好像有人在跟踪我！不止如此，我和张远很熟悉，他家我经常来，我发现被封锁的张家，居然被人动过，非但如此，我在张家院墙外，还发现了一些可疑的脚印。”
李皓迅速道：“张家这边，早就没有什么人了，这条街大半都搬迁走了。张家在街道最深处，按理说这里是不该有人来的……”
“带我去看看！”
刘隆说话，不容反驳，下一刻，转头看向后面那一大队人马，冷声道：“封锁整片街道，挨家挨户地搜查，查问是否有陌生人来此！”
“不许放走任何人！胆敢反抗，就地击毙！”

“是！”
一群人领命，迅速行动，动作都极快，很快整个街道都喧闹起来。
而李皓没管这些，带着刘隆到了张家围墙外的一处阴暗之地。
不需要李皓说什么。
刘隆是老巡检，一眼看到了地上几个浅浅的脚印，他迅速蹲下，仔细查看了一番，眼神微微有些变幻。
“哼！”
刘隆眼神发冷，身旁还跟着几位执法队精英，此刻都默默无声，等待着队长的命令。
“吴超，你来看看！”
刘隆并未说什么，而是让跟着他的一人上前查看，那人要专业的多，手上还戴着白色手套，迅速蹲下查看。
片刻后，在李皓眼中只是几个脚印的线索，这位人到中年的瘦弱巡检，却是给出了很多东西。
“嫌疑人，男性！身高180左右，体重不知，脚印浅薄，痕迹最深的，应该是两个小时前左右留下，最浅的，恐怕超过半年。”
“实力不弱，从留下的脚印来看，不低于二等，可能更强！”
此话一出，李皓有些古怪，但是没说话。
刘隆倒是不在意这个，也知道李皓这个机要室文员可能不知，淡淡道：“执法队给危险分子定级，不考虑武器之类，单纯从身手来分的话，执法队将这些危险分子分为三等！”
“一等最强，三等最弱！”
“能正面杀了你们一个机要室成员的，那就是三等悍匪！”
李皓有些尴尬，轻声道：“我们机要室总共28人，还有一些老巡检……”
言外之意，刘隆是否夸张了。
刘隆那是一点也不客气，冷笑一声：“你机要室室长王杰，之前倒是不弱，有点本事，否则也混不到室长一职！可自从多年前调职进入机要室，早就生疏，不再锻炼。如今，我执法队，哪怕寻常一位执法队员，也能要他的命！更别说被我们定为危险分子的悍匪！”
“你要明白，不是所有匪徒都配被我们定级为危险分子，凡是有定级的，都是极其危险的人物！”

“三年前，银城发生一起灭门惨案，一夜赤手空拳击杀胡家32人的那个混蛋，就是我们所说的三级悍匪！”
“银城多年来，能被定级的匪徒没有几人。”
此话一出，李皓倒是了然。
三等悍匪，居然就这么可怕了。
当然，这是执法队的定级标准，不是通用标准，机要室这边倒是少有人提。
想到之前那个巡检，也就是吴超口中所说的二等甚至一等，李皓眼神微变，不算太意外，那位可能是神秘者，而执法队定义的，一般也就是一些普通人。
是二等还是一等，甚至超越一等，都很正常。
李皓只是惊讶于，哪怕只是三等悍匪，居然都这么厉害，那神秘者可能超乎自己的想象。
而且，他更惊讶于对方只是看脚印就能判断出许多东西。
此刻，那个瘦弱中年，也就是刘隆口中的吴超，侧头看了一眼李皓，带着一些有些渗人的微笑，轻声道：“小李同志，是不是觉得我胡说八道？”
李皓急忙摇头：“没有，只是好奇吴大哥的本事……”
“银城古院的学员，这么谦虚的吗？”
吴超幽幽笑道：“古院的学员，一个个眼高于顶，你倒是不一样，不过也对，你退学了，现在也是巡检司一员！”
好像故意在李皓面前展露一般，吴超轻轻一蹬脚，弹跳的极高，瞬间落地，在地面上留下一个脚印。
此刻，吴超幽幽笑道：“身手不同的人，落地的反应不同，留下的脚印深浅不一，甚至整个脚印前后部位，哪个部位先落下，落地的具体姿势，都能还原出来！”
“再由他的落地姿势，进行反推，从而也能判断出更多的信息……现场发现的脚印，深浅不一，落地之时，应该是从几米高的高地落下，留下的脚印却是不够深，代表对方可以轻松控制全身肌肉……”
他解释了一番，正常情况下，没这个必要。
可眼前的李皓，是今晚的当事人，也是古院退学的学员，但是还是和古院有千丝万缕的关系，他多说了几句。
而刘隆一直默默听着，并未阻止。
等吴超说完了，刘隆冷冷道：“行了！他又不是执法队的，没必要说太多！”

李皓笑了笑没说话。
而刘隆看向四周，再看看张家老屋，冷声道：“胆子不小，杀人之后，居然还在这监视多日！”
吴超幽幽笑道：“队长，对方胆子大，那不是正常的吗？咱们银城执法队……也未必能奈何对方。”
“奈何不得？”
刘隆眼神瞬间冰寒无比，“那也未必！有些人，总觉得自己高人一等，不把一切放在眼中，可这些年来……咱们银城执法队，难道没杀过那些高高在上的家伙？”
此话一出，其他几位执法队员，都是幽冷一笑。
而李皓，却是心中微动。
什么意思？
难道这位说的是神秘者？
银城的执法队，杀过超能神秘人？
就在李皓想这些的时候，刘隆扭头一看李皓，声音依旧冰冷：“小家伙，有时候要相信执法队的实力！我知道你找袁教授，也许有自己的想法，看起来你不蠢，你能耗费时间，从如海的案卷中，找出六起自焚案，并且并案处理，代表你是个有耐心，有智慧的人！咱们巡检司，需要你这样细心的人！”
“你没找执法队，顾虑很多，刘某都懂！”
刘隆声音淡漠：“但是，你要的，甚至超越我执法队所谓的一等悍匪！但是，那又如何？”
刘隆身上煞气忽然浓郁起来，带着一些冰寒之意，风衣起伏。
“在银城，是龙也得盘着！不是没了巡夜人，就办不成事了！巡夜人当中一些弱者，本队长也不是没有揍过！”
一声冷哼，代表着这位队长的不满。
而李皓，却是有些目瞪口呆。
真的假的？
关键是，这位居然直接说出了巡夜人，直接道破了李皓的心思。
他知道李皓猜到了什么，觉得这案子涉及到了神秘力量，显然，这位也是这么想的，可是依旧没有去找巡夜人，看样子是准备让执法队自己处理。

哪来的自信？
这一刻，李皓脑筋迅速转动，下一秒，有些尴尬，低声道：“队长的意思我不懂……”
“虚伪！”
刘隆冷喝一声，“有什么不懂的！你一个能在无数案件中查出6起自焚案的家伙，看的案卷一定无数，你不懂谁懂？别告诉我，你不知道巡夜人的存在！没什么可顾忌的，别人不敢说，不代表巡检司不能说！巡夜人再厉害，也有人管着！”
“李皓，来说，我们都是同僚，说说怎么了，他们还能如何？巡夜人第一大忌就是对自己人下手，也不敢，更不会！所以，只要你行得正，怕什么巡夜人，直接骂他们都没事！”
“……”
李皓仿佛第一次认识这位，有些目瞪口呆。
真的假的？
大家忌惮不已，连说都不敢说的巡夜人，怎么在这位口中，好像不值一提一样。
就在这时候，刘隆身后，一位年纪不算小的女巡检轻笑一声，玩味道：“小家伙，队长也许有些吹嘘，不过正如队长所言，没必要太忌讳什么！大家不提，只是因为那些家伙太晦气，每次出现都代表有大案发生，是不祥的预兆。”
“胡说什么！”
刘隆发怒，因为他的队员说他吹嘘了！
女队员笑了，笑的风情万种，也不在意，再次看向李皓，笑道：“队长和我们，有兴趣和时间和你说这么多，其实是想告诉你，机要室多没意思，小李皓，来执法队如何？”
李皓这次真的愣住了。
什么意思？
而刘隆，依旧冷着脸，却是语气平和了一些，“我看你有点小聪明，也有耐心和义气，还算能过眼！来执法队，给你二级巡检，主要做一些案情分析……”
女队员再次插话，带着风情万种的笑容：“简单来说，执法队需要精英人才！尤其是你这种能在万千案件中发现关键，串联六案的文化人！执法队的粗人多，做事全凭经验和身手，案件分析能力不强。有时候明明发现了一些线索，却是无法继续追查出更多，不得不放弃很多案子。”
“包括张远自焚案，其实执法队隐约也曾发现过一些端倪，只是当时没往深处想，加上其他五起案子，执法队都没在意，没能串联到一起，否则，早就开始并案处理了！那自然也就知道，这案子不简单。”
他们居然是来拉人的！
李皓无语的同时，也是有些意外。

执法队居然要拉自己进入他们的行列，要知道，这位队长，刚刚到现在，都是一直冷言冷语，李皓还以为刘隆对自己很不满呢。
而刘隆再次开口，依旧是那张冷脸，“你加入我们，自焚案才有希望更快的破除！就算执法队真的无法解决，大不了找巡夜人来处理，我们找他们，顺理成章！你指望你的老师去找，还不知道欠下多少人情！”
这话，一下子戳中了李皓！
这位队长不简单！
就这么一句话，让李皓有些断了让袁硕帮忙的心思，因为正如他所言，找老师，老师得欠下大人情的！
刘隆很快高冷道：“先这么说，自己考虑！此事只是小事，爱来不来！执法队不缺精英！当务之急，是抓到那个家伙，通知大家，都小心一点，是个高手，也许还是超能者！”
说罢，刘隆迈步就走，朝张家宅院走去。
而李皓急忙跟上，正在思考着怎么让这位推平张家大宅，虽说这是小远的家，可人都不在了，为了给小远报仇，李皓相信小远不会在意的。
不等李皓开口，刘隆就主动喝道：“来人，搜查张家！若是搜查不到任何有用线索，直接推平张家，掘地三尺，还是没有收获，那就放火烧了宅院，我倒想看看，一直盯了这么久，到底想找什么？老子一把火烧了，哪怕是超能物品，也得现身！”
“……”
李皓暗暗吸气，我还没说呢，这位看起来莽，实际上……真莽！
当然，这也是一个极好的办法。
不管你们在找什么，我一把火烧了，你真想要，你会不会现身？
这位的办案风格，还真是……真是符合李皓的口味啊！
“执法队……”
李皓也是巡检，对执法队不陌生。
可今日，好像重新认识了他眼中无能的执法队。
这位刘隆队长带领的执法队，真的那么无能吗？
可执法队，如同筛子，这也是事实，李皓上报的案子，一眨眼就被泄露了，这也代表执法队内部也是一团糟。
就在李皓思考的时候，之前那风情万种的女队员，忽然凑近了李皓，笑的灿烂：“小李，队长就是这性格，别介意！你也是巡检，当知道一些执法队的行事风格。队长还是很希望你能加入执法队的，别看他说的不在意，实际上很希望你能和我们成为队友。”

“这……”
李皓被弄的有些懵，有必要吗？
自己只是上报了一件案子罢了。
女队员轻笑一声，声音降低了一些：“队长之前就说，执法队什么都不缺，不缺战力，不缺武器，不缺权柄，可是唯独缺了一位细心而又和执法队关联不大的聪明人！”
李皓迅速思考这话的意思，还没等他想完，女队员就轻叹一声，幽幽的话语在李皓耳边响起：“执法队，内鬼不少啊！队长想清理门户，可惜有心无力，空有一身好本事，却是连人都找不到，又不愿伤了大家的心，不能大张旗鼓地查……你来，也许也有这个目的，希望你能用你的智慧，查出自焚案的细心，一点点剥丝抽茧，将执法队的蛀虫找出来！”
李皓一愣！
刘隆知道！
不但知道执法队有内鬼，还有心去查，只是好像顾忌很多，一直没有动手。
刘隆招揽自己，居然是想让自己当这把刀，这是李皓完全没想到的。
就在李皓迟疑的刹那，女队员又幽幽笑道：“考虑一下吧！你朋友的案子，也许很麻烦，今晚做做样子罢了，也许最终还是需要巡夜人插手，而你加入执法队，就有希望和巡夜人一起参与，否则，机要室是没资格参与这起案子的！”
“你为了你朋友，甘心退学，进入机要室查了一年的陈年旧案，一年下来，也够了，难不成还想继续在机要室养老？”
李皓再次有些走神，他发现，今晚倒是自己走神比较多。
印象中无能的执法队，却是一次次颠覆他的想象。
眼前这几位，没一个简单的。
哪怕拉人，也是句句说到了李皓心坎中。
这一刻，李皓忽然有些担心，刚刚提前取出了石刀，不会被执法队发现什么吧？
之前，他担心被红影一方发现，却是不担心被执法队发现。
刚刚刘隆说拆屋烧屋，李皓都觉得没什么事了，可是……执法队会发现烟囱上的问题吗？
替换的石头，能瞒住他们吗？
“算了，一切都推到红影那边，反正我不知道，我什么都不知道。”

李皓心中暗暗说着，有些忌惮起来。
果然，人不能太高估自己了，他以为一切都很顺利，没想到，执法队这边却是打了他一个措手不及，自己在机要室一年，还真小看了巡检司。
“加入执法队……”
李皓继续跟着，却是已经有些走神了。
冷酷霸道的队长，风情万种又句句戳中人心的女队员，一眼就能看出无数线索的吴超……这执法队，有些藏龙卧虎的感觉啊！
连自己小看的执法队都如此，那巡夜人呢？
自己之前还妄想加入巡夜人……李皓真怕自己死都不知道怎么死的，这些人太老辣了，和他们在一起时间长了，李皓觉得自己什么都瞒不过去。
这一刻，李皓忽然觉得有些凉飕飕的。
“外面的世界好可怕，机要室简直就是儿童乐园，还是机要室舒服！”
李皓抖了抖脑袋，再看前面的刘隆，忽然觉得，这位说要拆房烧房，是不是有试探自己的意思。
通篇没问过自己有没有发现什么，找到什么，好像一切都不需要问。
如此一来，反而让自己更加忌惮了。
“自己刚刚没笑吧？应该没有！”
李皓回想了一下，有些庆幸，幸好自己还算稳健，哪怕刘隆说了自己想要做的，自己也是面不改色，嗯，值得表扬！
content_en:
10pm.
Boom!
There was a sound of cars, and the quiet old street had not been so lively for a long time.
At this moment, the lights shine brightly and the entire old street area comes alive.
In front of Zhang's house.
Li Hao watched this scene silently. He didn't want to be too high-profile, but when the situation reached this point, he had already begun to have contact with Hong Ying, and Li Hao also changed his mind.
Hidden away from the city!
High profile may also be another kind of low profile.
He was so high-profile that everyone knew that he just wanted to avenge Zhang Yuan. He had no other purpose and no other discovery. He had to resort to external forces. He didn't know the crisis behind it and didn't know the inside story, so he just messed around.
This kind of Li Hao may be the Li Hao some people want to see.
Young, impulsive, reckless, but loyal!
Has brains, but lacks some calculations.
There is little cleverness but no great wisdom.
This is the image Li Hao wants to establish!
It lowers the enemy's alertness without making people feel particularly stupid. If it is too stupid, how can Li Hao get into Yuan Shuo's eyes? It is really too fake.
Before taking a step, Li Hao would think about what this step would bring to him and what he would lose.
Obviously he just took away a small stone, but he made a big show of it and caused a storm in the city!
The reason why the noise was so loud was to cover up the fact that he had taken away a small stone. If word spread, no one would believe it. This was the result Li Hao needed. The more exaggerated it was, the less likely no one would think about it.
Boom!
The sound of leather boots hitting the ground came, and a team of heavily armed patrolmen quickly surrounded the entire old street. Soon, the door of Zhang's house was also inspected by the Inspection Department.
The director of the inspection department did not come.
However, Li Hao recognized the strong man in front of the crowd at a glance. He was the captain of the law enforcement team of the Inspection Department, and could even be said to be the real second-in-command of the Inspection Department.
They are said to be at the same level as Wang Jie, the head of the Confidential Office, but in fact they have completely different powers.
Liu Long, the captain of the law enforcement team, is quite big.
He was not wearing a black patrol uniform, but was wearing casual clothes with a windbreaker outside. In this season, it was not appropriate.
However, Li Hao knew that there might be densely packed weapons under the windbreaker.
He knew the style of the captain of the law enforcement team.
A very tough and courageous person.
The Yincheng Inspection Department is still very prestigious in Yincheng, and this captain has a lot of lives on his hands.
"Who is Li Hao?"
Liu Long stepped forward, his leather boots even crushed the stones on the ground. Li Hao, who saw him from a distance, had a twinkle in his eye.
He is a master!
The Inspection Department may not have super-mysterious people, but there are also some fighting masters and some actual combat masters, all of whom are one against ten.
The captain of the law enforcement team is obviously not weak in combat ability.
"Report, I am Li Hao!"
Li Hao also quickly stepped forward, stood up straight, raised his chest, and spoke crisply.
"The Yincheng inspection driver asked for Level 3 inspection Li Hao! He was ordered to investigate the case and met Captain Liu!"
"Hmph!"
Liu Long snorted coldly, his voice extremely cold and stern.
A look like a sharp sword was directed at Li Hao, with some coldness, majesty and anger: "Li Hao, as a member of the Inspection Department, you are a disgrace to the Inspection Department!"
Li Hao frowned.
Liu Long's voice was loud, with some unwillingness and anger, like a tiger roaring, and he didn't even care about anyone hearing it.
"What is the Inspection Department? It is a law enforcement agency! It is the only and most critical law enforcement agency in the entire Yin City! As a member of the Inspection Department, if you have any discoveries or any crises, you can directly seek help from the Inspection Department!"
"Why interfere with the law enforcement of the Inspection Department through the hands of outsiders?"
Liu Long's voice was loud, and with the intimidation of a tiger, he stepped forward and approached Li Hao. This step seemed to have spanned a hundred or ten meters, and he appeared in front of Li Hao in the blink of an eye.
Li Hao's heart condensed.
Really a master!
He has met Liu Long, but he had never seen Liu Long in this state. Li Hao felt that he was still somewhat capable, but he believed that he might not even be able to draw out his gun in front of this person.
Is this... a mysterious person?
Or is this just a kind of power produced by ordinary people who have been trained to the extreme?
Li Hao was a little intimidated. He lowered his head and said in a low voice with some trembling: "I don't dare! I just asked for help from my teacher. I didn't expect that the inspection department would start a big fight. Because I have no evidence, I don't have the nerve to ask for help from the inspection department..."
Liu Long snorted and seemed to agree with the reply. He said coldly: "If there is no evidence, then find it! Why are you embarrassed? Tell me, what happened here?"
Li Hao suppressed the shock in his heart and whispered: "I have reported the self-immolation case. I wonder if Captain Liu knows about it?"
"Know!"
"Zhang Yuan and I are good friends. I want to come tonight to check if there are any clues about Zhang Yuan's family, because I am convinced that Zhang Yuan was killed and did not die in an accident..."
Li Hao calmed down and said in a deep voice: "I came to Zhang Yuan's house, and someone seemed to be following me! Not only that, Zhang Yuan and I are very familiar, and I often come to his house. I found that the sealed Zhang family had been disturbed. Not only that, I also found some suspicious footprints outside the wall of Zhang Yuan's courtyard."
Li Hao said quickly: "There are no people around the Zhang family for a long time. Most of this street has been moved away. The Zhang family is at the deepest part of the street. Logically speaking, no one should come here..."
"Take me to see it!"
Liu Long spoke without allowing for refutation. The next moment, he turned to look at the large group of people behind him and said in a cold voice: "Seal the entire street and search from house to house to see if there are any strangers here!"
"Don't let anyone go! If you dare to resist, you will be shot on the spot!"
"Yes!"
A group of people took the order and acted quickly, very fast, and soon the whole street was noisy.
But Li Hao didn't care about this and took Liu Long to a dark place outside the Zhang family wall.
Li Hao didn't need to say anything.
Liu Long was an old patrol inspector. He saw a few shallow footprints on the ground at a glance. He quickly squatted down and looked carefully, his eyes changing slightly.
"Hmph!"
Liu Long's eyes were cold, and he was followed by several law enforcement team elites. They were all silent at the moment, waiting for the captain's order.
"Wu Chao, come and take a look!"
Liu Long didn't say anything, but asked the person following him to come forward to check. The man was much more professional and wore white gloves on his hands. He quickly squatted down to check.
After a while, in Li Hao's eyes, there were only a few clues of footprints, but the thin inspection of this middle-aged man revealed a lot.
"The suspect is a male! He is about 180cm tall and his weight is unknown. His footprints are shallow. The deepest one should have been left about two hours ago. The shallowest one is probably more than half a year old."
"The strength is not weak. Judging from the footprints left behind, it is no less than second-class, and may be stronger!"
As soon as these words came out, Li Hao felt a little weird, but he didn't say anything.
Liu Long didn't care about this, and knew that Li Hao, the secret room clerk, might not know, and said calmly: "The law enforcement team ranks dangerous elements, regardless of weapons and the like. If they are purely based on skill, the law enforcement team will classify these dangerous elements into three levels!"
"The first level is the strongest, the third level is the weakest!"
"Anyone who can kill one of your confidential room members head-on is a third-class gangster!"
Li Hao was a little embarrassed and said softly: "We have a total of 28 people in the confidential room, and there are also some old patrol inspectors..."
The implication is that Liu Long is exaggerating.
Liu Long was not polite at all, and sneered: "Wang Jie, the head of the confidential room, was not weak before and had some abilities, otherwise he would not have been able to get the position of head! But since he was transferred to the confidential room many years ago, he has become rusty and has stopped exercising. Now, even an ordinary law enforcement member of our law enforcement team can kill him! Let alone one who is designated by us as the head of the confidential room.Dangerous gangsters! "
"You have to understand that not all gangsters are worthy of being classified as dangerous by us. Anyone who is classified is an extremely dangerous person! "
"Three years ago, a massacre occurred in Yincheng. The bastard who killed 32 members of the Hu family in one night with his bare hands was what we call a third-level gangster! "
“Over the years in Yincheng, there have been very few gangsters who can be classified. "
As soon as these words came out, Li Hao understood.
A third-class bandit is actually so terrifying.
Of course, this is the grading standard for law enforcement teams, not a universal standard. Few people mention it in the confidential room.
Thinking of the previous inspection, which was what Wu Chao said was second-class or even first-class, Li Hao's eyes changed slightly. It was not too surprising. That person might be a mysterious person, and the law enforcement team generally defined it as ordinary people.
Whether it is second-class or first-class, or even beyond first-class, is normal.
Li Hao was just surprised that even a third-level gangster could be so powerful. The mysterious person might be beyond his imagination.
Moreover, he was even more surprised that the other party could tell many things just by looking at the footprints.
At this moment, the thin middle-aged man, Wu Chao in Liu Long's mouth, glanced sideways at Li Hao, with a perceptive smile, and said softly: "Comrade Li, do you think I'm talking nonsense? "
Li Hao shook his head hastily: "No, I'm just curious about Brother Wu's ability..."
"Are the students of Yincheng Ancient Academy so humble? "
Wu Chao smiled faintly and said: "The students of the Ancient Academy all have their eyes set high above their heads. You are different, but that's right. You dropped out of school and now you are also a member of the Inspection Department! "
As if he was deliberately showing off in front of Li Hao, Wu Chao lightly kicked his foot, bounced extremely high, and landed instantly, leaving a footprint on the ground.
At this moment, Wu Chao smiled faintly and said: "People with different skills have different reactions to landing, and the footprints they leave are of different depths. Even the front and back parts of the entire footprints, which part fell first, and the specific landing posture can be restored!" "
"Then we can infer more information based on his landing posture... The footprints found at the scene are of different depths. When he landed, he should have fallen from a height of several meters. However, the footprints left behind were not deep enough, which means that the opponent can easily control the muscles of his body..."
He explained that under normal circumstances, this would not be necessary.
But the Li Hao in front of him was the person involved tonight, and he was also a student who dropped out of Guyuan, but he was still inextricably related to Guyuan, so he said a few more words.
Liu Long listened silently and did not stop him.
After Wu Chao finished speaking, Liu Long said coldly: "Okay! He is not from the law enforcement team, so there is no need to say too much! "
Li Hao smiled and said nothing.
Liu Long looked around, then looked at the Zhang family's old house, and said coldly: "You are so courageous. After killing someone, you actually continued to monitor here for many days! "
Wu Chao smiled faintly and said: "Captain, isn't it normal for the other party to be bold? Our Yincheng Law Enforcement Team... may not be able to do anything to the other party. "
"Why not? "
Liu Long's eyes were extremely cold for a moment, "That's not necessarily the case! Some people always feel that they are superior to others and don't take everything seriously, but over the years...haven't our Yincheng Law Enforcement Team killed those superior guys? "
As soon as these words came out, several other law enforcement members all smiled coldly.
But Li Hao's heart moved slightly.
What does it mean?
Could this be a mysterious person?
Did Yincheng's law enforcement team kill a mysterious mysterious man with super powers?
Just when Li Hao was thinking about this, Liu Long turned to look at Li Hao, his voice still cold: "Little guy, sometimes you have to believe in the strength of the law enforcement team! I know that you may have your own ideas when you come to Professor Yuan. It seems that you are not stupid. You can spend time to find six cases of self-immolation from Ruhai's case files and handle them together. It means that you are a patient and wise person! Our inspection department needs you to be so careful.people! "
"You didn't call the law enforcement team, you have a lot of worries, and Liu understands that! "
Liu Long's voice was indifferent: "But what you want is even more than the so-called first-class gangsters of our law enforcement team! But so what? "
The evil aura on Liu Long's body suddenly became thicker, with a hint of coldness, and his windbreaker heaved.
"In Yincheng, even a dragon must be coiled! It’s not that without the night watchman, nothing can be done! It’s not like this captain hasn’t beaten some of the weak ones among the night watchmen! "
A cold snort represented the captain's dissatisfaction.
Li Hao, on the other hand, was a little stunned.
Real or fake?
The key is that this person directly told the night watchman, directly revealing Li Hao's thoughts.
He knew what Li Hao had guessed and felt that this case involved mysterious forces. Obviously, this person thought so too, but he still did not go to the night watchman. It seemed that he was planning to let the law enforcement team handle it on their own.
Where does the confidence come from?
At this moment, Li Hao's mind was spinning rapidly. The next second, he felt a little embarrassed and whispered: "I don't understand what the captain means..."
"Hypocrisy! "
Liu Long shouted coldly, "What don't you understand? You are a guy who can find 6 cases of self-immolation among countless cases. You must have read countless case files. If you don't understand, who will? Don't tell me you don't know the night watchman exists! There is nothing to worry about. Just because others dare not say it, does not mean that the inspection department cannot say it! No matter how powerful the night watchman is, he still has someone to look after him! "
"Li Hao, come on, we are all colleagues, tell us what happened, what else can they do? The number one taboo of night watchmen is to attack one of their own people. They dare not, let alone not do it! So, as long as you behave upright, you will be fine if you are afraid of night watchmen and just scold them! "
"..."
Li Hao seemed to be meeting this person for the first time, and was a little stunned.
Real or fake?
Everyone is so afraid of the night watchman that they don't even dare to talk about it. Why does this person seem to be not worth mentioning?
At this moment, behind Liu Long, a relatively young female inspector chuckled and said playfully: "Little guy, the captain may be a bit bragging, but as the captain said, there is no need to be too taboo about anything! No one mentions it, just because those guys are too unlucky. Every time they appear, it means that a major crime has occurred, which is an ominous omen. "
"What nonsense! "
Liu Long was angry because his team members said he was bragging!
The female team member smiled, her smile was charming, and she didn't care. She looked at Li Hao again and said with a smile: "Captain and we have the interest and time to talk to you so much. In fact, we want to tell you that the confidential room is boring. Little Li Hao, how about coming to the law enforcement team? "
Li Hao was really stunned this time.
What does it mean?
Liu Long, on the other hand, still had a cold face, but his tone was calmer, "I think you are a little smart, and you have patience and loyalty, so you can get by! Come to the law enforcement team to give you a second-level inspection, mainly to do some case analysis..."
The female team member interrupted again, with a charming smile: "Simply put, the law enforcement team needs elite talents! Especially an intellectual like you who can find the key among thousands of cases and connect six cases in series! There are many rough people in the law enforcement team, and they rely solely on experience and skill to do their work, and their case analysis skills are not strong. Sometimes some clues are discovered, but they are unable to continue to track down more, and many cases have to be abandoned. "
"Including the case of Zhang Yuan's self-immolation, the law enforcement team actually discovered some clues, but they didn't think about it in depth at the time. In addition to the other five cases, the law enforcement team didn't pay attention to them and failed to connect them together. Otherwise, the cases would have been merged and handled long ago! Naturally, we know that this case is not simple. "
They actually came to pull people away!
While Li Hao was speechless, he was also a little surprised.
The law enforcement team actually wanted to drag him into their ranks. You know, the captain had been making sarcastic remarks until now. Li Hao thought Liu Long was very dissatisfied with him.
Liu Long spoke again, still with the same cold face, "If you join us, there will be hope for the self-immolation case."Break faster! Even if the law enforcement team really can't solve it, the worst case scenario is to find the night watchmen, so it's natural for us to find them! You expect your teacher to find you, but you don’t know how many favors you owe! "
These words hit Li Hao immediately!
This captain is not simple!
Just such a sentence made Li Hao stop thinking about asking Yuan Shuo for help, because as he said, if you want to find a teacher, the teacher will owe you a favor!
Liu Long quickly said coldly: "Let me put it this way first, think about it yourself! This matter is just a trivial matter, whether love comes or not! There is no shortage of elites in the law enforcement team! The top priority is to catch that guy and inform everyone to be careful. He is a master, maybe a superpower! "
After saying that, Liu Long took a step and walked towards the Zhang family's residence.
And Li Hao hurriedly followed, thinking about how to let this man bulldoze the Zhang family mansion. Although this was Xiao Yuan's home, no one was there. In order to avenge Xiao Yuan, Li Hao believed that Xiao Yuan would not care.
Before Li Hao could speak, Liu Long shouted: "Come here, search the Zhang family! If you can't find any useful clues, you can bulldoze Zhang's house and dig three feet into the ground, but still get nothing, then set fire to the house. I would like to see what I am looking for after staring at it for so long. I'm on fire, even if it's a super item, it has to show up! "
"..."
Li Hao secretly breathed in. I haven't said anything yet. This person looks reckless, but in fact... he is really reckless!
Of course, this is also an excellent method.
No matter what you are looking for, I set it on fire. If you really want it, will you show up?
This person's case-handling style really... really suits Li Hao's taste!
"Law enforcement team..."
Li Hao is also on patrol and is no stranger to the law enforcement team.
But today, it seemed that he had gotten to know the incompetent law enforcement team again.
Is the law enforcement team led by Captain Liu Long really so incompetent?
But the law enforcement team is like a sieve. This is also true. The case reported by Li Hao was leaked in the blink of an eye. This also means that the law enforcement team is also in a mess.
Just when Li Hao was thinking, the charming female team member from before suddenly approached Li Hao and smiled brightly: "Xiao Li, this is the character of the captain, don't mind! You are also on patrol, so you should know the behavior of some law enforcement teams. The captain still hopes that you can join the law enforcement team. Despite his indifference, he actually hopes that you can become teammates with us. "
"This..."
Li Hao was confused. Is it necessary?
I just reported a case.
The female team member chuckled and lowered her voice: "The captain said before that the law enforcement team lacks everything, no lack of combat power, no lack of weapons, no lack of authority, but it only lacks a smart man who is careful and has little connection with the law enforcement team! "
Li Hao quickly thought about the meaning of these words. Before he could finish thinking about it, the female team member sighed softly, and faint words rang in Li Hao's ears: "There are a lot of moles in the law enforcement team! The captain wanted to clean up the house, but unfortunately he was powerless and had no good skills, but he couldn't find anyone, and he didn't want to hurt everyone's hearts, so he couldn't investigate in a big way... You may also have this purpose in coming. I hope you can use your wisdom to investigate the self-immolation case, peel off the silk and cocoon little by little, and find out the moth in the law enforcement team! "
Li Hao was stunned!
Liu Long knows!
Not only did he know that there was a mole in the law enforcement team, but he also wanted to investigate, but he seemed to have too many worries and never took action.
When Liu Long recruited him, he actually wanted him to be the sword. This was something Li Hao never expected.
Just when Li Hao hesitated, the female team member smiled faintly and said: "Think about it! Your friend's case may be very troublesome. It's just a show tonight, but it may eventually require the intervention of the night watchman. If you join the law enforcement team, you can hope to participate together with the night watchman. Otherwise, the confidentiality room will not be qualified to participate in this case! "
"You are willing to drop out of school for your friend and enter the confidential room to checkA year's worth of old cases is enough. Is it possible that I still want to continue to live in a confidential room? "
Li Hao was a little distracted again. He found that he was more distracted tonight.
The incompetent law enforcement team in his impression subverted his imagination time and time again.
None of these people in front of me is simple.
Even if he pulls people in, every word he says goes to Li Hao's heart.
At this moment, Li Hao was suddenly worried. He had just taken out the stone knife in advance. Wouldn't the law enforcement team discover anything?
Before, he was worried about being discovered by Hongying's party, but he was not worried about being discovered by the law enforcement team.
Just now Liu Long said that he was demolishing the house and burning it down. Li Hao thought it was okay, but... will the law enforcement team discover the problem on the chimney?
Can the replacement stone be hidden from them?
"Forget it, push everything to Hongying's side, anyway, I don't know, I don't know anything. "
Li Hao said secretly in his heart, feeling a little wary.
Sure enough, one should not overestimate oneself. He thought everything was going smoothly, but unexpectedly, the law enforcement team caught him off guard. He had been in the confidential room for a year, and he really underestimated the inspection department.
"Join the law enforcement team..."
Li Hao continued to follow, but he was already a little distracted.
The cold and domineering captain, the charming female team member who speaks words that touch people's hearts, Wu Chao who can spot countless clues at a glance... This law enforcement team feels like a hidden dragon and a crouching tiger!
Even the law enforcement team that I underestimated was like this, but what about the night watchmen?
He had previously dreamed of joining the night watchmen... Li Hao was really afraid that he would die without knowing how. These people were so sophisticated. After spending time with them for a long time, Li Hao felt that he could not hide anything.
At this moment, Li Hao suddenly felt a little chilly.
"The outside world is so scary, the confidential room is like a children's paradise, but the confidential room is so comfortable! "
Li Hao shook his head and looked at Liu Long in front of him. He suddenly felt that this man who wanted to demolish the house and burn it down was trying to test him.
Throughout the article, I never asked myself whether I had discovered anything or what I had found. It seemed that there was no need to ask about anything.
As a result, it made me even more afraid.
"You didn't laugh just now, did you? Probably not! "
Li Hao thought about it and felt a little lucky. Fortunately, he was quite steady. Even if Liu Long said what he wanted to do, his expression remained unchanged. Well, it deserves praise!
